description: Add, change or remove a block of the house — a box with its own walls, roof and openings: a wing (L or T shape), a garage, a porch, a bay. A new block needs center, width, depth and wallHeight; it takes the main block's walls and roof material, with a gable roof you can change with house_set_roof {block}. Open roofs on posts — a porch on posts, a carport, a pergola: add the posts as thin blocks (width and depth 0.4 m or less: they get no roof and no plinth; give them a wood, render or concrete finish with house_set_walls), then the roof as a block with open: true (no walls; its roof hangs at its wallHeight, a gable's ends stay clad; a plinthHeight gives it a deck underneath) and set its roof (gable, shed or flat — a flat one is a thin sheet). Blocks may overlap the main block (a wing joined to it). The main block's size and place come from the outline: change only its wallHeight here. House frame: stand in front of the house facing its front facade; x runs to your right, z towards you, metres from the main block's centre. Facades: front, back, left, right as seen from the front. An opening's offset is measured on its own facade standing outside facing it: from that facade's LEFT end to the opening's centre.

block.description: Block id: a new id adds a block (e.g. garage, wing, porch)

center.description: Block centre in the house frame, m

open.description: Open sides: no walls, the roof hangs at wallHeight (a porch's or carport's roof on posts)

plinthHeight.description: This block's base band (e.g. 0 for a garage)

width.description: Along x (left to right as seen from the front), m

name: house_set_block
